question: Why does Ananta not look upward toward the world of Kalagni?
premises: The worlds fear being reduced to ashes by Kalagni.
Although he pervades the universe, Kalagni threatens to burn this earth.
inference: Even a pervasive cosmic lord avoids looking toward Kalagni because of its destructive fire.
plain_english: He does not look upward, for fear that the worlds would be reduced to ashes; and although he pervades the universe, he avoids that direction because Kalagni would scorch this earth.
